show.description: Rejected, ridiculed, and denied his place in a legendary Gurukul, a determined underdog rises against fate—driven by a forbidden love and a promise he refuses to break—until his buried power explodes, shaking gods and masters alike, revealing a terrifying truth: he may be the long-feared heir to the all-powerful Kaal-Vansh.
